title: John Harbaugh on Jaxson Dart's trips to medical tent: I'm sure his history comes into play

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh on Jaxson Dart's trips to medical tent: I'm sure his history comes into play
sources.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart said he was "puzzled" by having to go into the sideline medical tent after taking a big hit during Saturday's preseason game against the Vikings because he feels like it happens to him more frequently than other quarterbacks.
